cited_by.title: Collagen supplements for skin and joints

record.population: Adults in 23 randomised trials of collagen supplements for skin ageing
record.design: Systematic review and meta-analysis split by funding source and study quality
record.finding: Across all trials, collagen improved hydration, elasticity and wrinkles. Trials not funded by pharmaceutical companies found no effect, as did high-quality trials, while industry-funded and low-quality trials found benefit. The authors conclude there is currently no clinical evidence to support collagen supplements to prevent or treat skin ageing.
record.note: The most careful reading of the evidence found. Skin type not reported in the abstract.
